name: analyzing-earnings-quality
description: Evaluates earnings quality for diligence, lenders, investment committees and equity research: tests quality of earnings (QoE) reports and management adjusted EBITDA, including addbacks or accruals that the QoE report or statements do not support and EBITDA addbacks and QoE adjustments an IC memo relies on; labels each adjustment supported, recurring, pro forma only, tailored or unsupported; flags "non-recurring" charges that recur, run-rate synergies, capitalized software costs, reserve releases (bad debt, warranty, inventory), related-party revenue and one-time gains in operating income; measures Sloan accruals, cash conversion (CFO to EBITDA), DSO and DIO, channel stuffing and bill-and-hold signals; computes the Beneish M-score with the 1999 coefficients and -1.78 cutoff; and reviews non-GAAP measures under Regulation G, S-K Item 10(e) and SEC staff interpretations. Use for QoE review, normalized EBITDA, earnings manipulation screen, accrual ratio or non-GAAP review. Drafts for review.
